title: Searching words of odd period for one without a certificate
claim: Proved, refereed by an independent session: the 12 not-all-equal knot kinds of span below 61 whose triples are translates of {0, s, 2s} mod 61, s in {1, 2, 11, 22} up to sign, allow exactly 122 repeating words (two orbits of period 61 swapped by the mirror, no two differing in one place), so every state they allow repeats with period 61 (lemma 4 of EVEN-PERIOD-20261112-001): an odd not-all-equal harmony, unsplit. Exact, complete: no word of period 31 or 37 lacks a certificate, so no harmony has period 31 or 37. Lemmas 5 to 8 (three from the advisor model) by hand. Targeted ranges found no other counterexample.
failure_conditions: Two of the 122 words differing in one place.
A state of the period-61 base on a long window breaking the 61-repeat.
A word of period 31 or 37 without a certificate.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law on bases along one shift; words of period 31 and 37 (complete), targeted ranges at 41, 43, 47 and the progression family at primes 31 to 61.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-12, pre-registered (commit be4f5a9d3); refereed by fresh code (odd_referee.py) and by an independent fresh model session (independent_referee/report.md).
validation.status: lemmas by hand; exhaustive search (check.py); both referees passed
